title: Rich Hedden
description: Rich Hedden explains why he depicted the Gamorrean guard: "I was under the impression that I was being paid by the pound, so I simply chose the most obese character I could find. Besides, they wouldn't let me do the third season Captain Kirk (similar girth, different universe)." Hedden's first experience in the professional comics biz came in 1986 with Dark Horse's ROACHMILL (he co-created the character). Later work includes mowing lawns, collecting unemployment checks, watching a lot of cable, TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES, THE DEMON, and mowing more lawns.
